rationale: The native WP3B-WP3E stack could not be merged through the available ordinary endpoint and no asynchronous stack-merge mutation was exposed. Each bounded packet was therefore reconstructed from the latest lawful main, independently passed the repository required checks including FINAL_HEAD, SIQ READY and stable-main readiness, and squash-merged serially. The original stack PRs were closed as superseded without force-push or history rewrite. This is an authority-neutral reconciliation only.
rollback: Correct forward only while preserving original stack PRs, replacement PRs, merge commits and Git history.
